items.title: S&P Global may sell parts of Capital IQ unit to Cognizant - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- Cognizant (NASDAQ:CTSH) is in talks to take over parts of S&P Global's (NYSE:SPGI) Capital IQ operations in a move that could see around 1,500 employees transfer to the IT services provider, according to a Reuters report citing two people familiar with the matter.
